transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I’m here because something’s been going on with my dad’s lab results. For about a year I’ve been trying to show that someone in the clinic system is changing things, or holding parts back.

People keep telling me the numbers are fine, doctors and my family, but… the chart doesn’t match what I saw. And it’s just been wearing me down.
Do you believe for certain that someone in the clinic system is changing or hiding your dad’s lab results?

Yes. I mean… I know how it sounds, but yes. I know what I saw, and the chart doesn’t match. For the past year I’ve been trying to prove someone is changing it or leaving parts out, even though everyone keeps telling me it’s fine.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t seem to hear or see?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I haven’t seen or heard anything like that. It’s more about the records not matching.
Have you had a period when your mood felt unusually high, energized, or irritable compared with your usual self?
Not really. I mean, I get stressed and frustrated, but I wouldn’t say unusually high or energized.
Have you felt like your thoughts were being put into your mind, taken out, or made known to other people?
No… I don’t think so. My thoughts feel like mine. I’m not aware of anything like that happening.
Over the past year, have you found yourself becoming much less interested in seeing people or doing things you used to enjoy?
I don’t know… not really. I still see people when I need to. I’ve just been keeping to myself more, I guess.
Have you had any periods of confusion where you felt disoriented or not clear-headed?
No, I don’t think so. I mean, I get tired or distracted sometimes, but not disoriented or anything like that.
Outside of the issue with your dad’s lab results, do you feel there are any other people or situations that are part of a plot against you or your family?

I don’t know about… a bigger plot. It’s mainly the clinic system. Someone there is changing things or holding parts of my dad’s lab results back. I know what I saw in the chart, and it doesn’t match what they keep telling me.

Everyone says the numbers are fine, but… they’re not listening. It’s been going on about a year, and it’s wearing me down.
Has this situation with your dad’s lab results caused serious problems in your work or daily life?

Yeah… I guess it has. My family doesn’t really include me in some of my dad’s appointment planning anymore.

And at work, I feel like they’ve kind of written me off for lab supervision. Like they think I get too… confrontational about record issues.
Have people close to you noticed that you seem emotionally flat or less expressive than you used to be?
I’m not sure. I don’t think anyone has said it like that. Maybe they think I’m quieter lately, but… I don’t know about flat.
Do you ever feel that outside forces are controlling your actions or your body?

No… not like controlling my body or making me do things.

It’s more that I feel like someone in the clinic system is changing things, or holding back parts of my dad’s lab results. I know what I saw in the chart, and it doesn’t match what they keep telling me. That’s what I can’t let go of.
Before this started, did you have any medical illness or head injury?
Not that I can think of. I mean… I haven’t had a head injury or anything like that. No major illness before all this, at least not that I know of.
Have other people told you that your speech is hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another?
No… I don’t think anyone’s said that. I can be careful with what I say, but I don’t think I’m hard to follow.
Over the past year, have you felt depressed most days?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say depressed most days. I’ve been stressed and worn down, but depressed… I’m not sure.
Do you believe anyone is trying to harm or target you personally?

I don’t know if “harm” is the right word. But… yes, I do think someone in the clinic system has been targeting my dad’s lab results. Changing them, or holding parts back. I know what I saw, and the chart doesn’t match. People keep telling me it’s fine, but it isn’t.
Is it possible that the clinic staff could really be changing or hiding your dad’s lab results, even if other people don’t believe you?

Yes. I mean… that’s why I’m here. I’ve spent the past year trying to prove it, and everyone keeps saying the numbers are fine, but the chart doesn’t match what I saw. So yes, I think someone in the clinic system is changing it or holding parts back. It’s… it’s wearing me down.
Is what you believe about the clinic something that could happen in real life, even if others disagree?

Yes. Things can get changed in a system. I work around labs—I know charts don’t just… explain themselves when something doesn’t match. I know what I saw with my dad’s results, and everyone keeps telling me it’s fine, but it doesn’t line up. That’s why I’ve been trying to prove it.
Did this belief about the clinic start suddenly?
Not all at once, no. It’s been… about a year, I guess. Since my dad started needing all those labs and appointments. It just built from there.
Do you ever hear voices speaking to you or about you when no one else is there?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I hear people talking at work or in the clinic, but not voices when no one’s there.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being broadcast so that other people could know them without you telling them?

No… not like that. I don’t think people can hear my thoughts.

It’s more about the clinic records—my dad’s lab results. Something in the chart doesn’t match what I saw, and I can’t just ignore that.
